subject: Exec-level onsite: Sept 8-10 — FinServ workshop & C-suite roundtable
messages:
From: Anjali Mehta <anjali.mehta@finserv.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Exec-level onsite: Sept 8-10 — FinServ workshop & C-suite roundtable

Hi Laura,

Hope you’re well. We’d like to invite Redwood to run a two-day senior workshop and a C-suite roundtable at our New York offices the week of Sept 8 — our preferred dates are Sept 9 (workshop) and Sept 10 (exec roundtable / dinner). The idea is a production-readiness workshop for our platform team during the day and an invitation-only dinner + 90-minute roundtable with our CEO (Rajiv), CIO (Priya), and three board members on the evening of the 10th.

Key asks from our side:
- Which Redwood execs would you recommend for the C-level roundtable? We expect top-level discussion: reliability, SLAs, data residency, and dedicated deployment options.
- Can your team come onsite for the workshop (3–4 engineers + 1 exec) and stay through the dinner?
- We’ll need an itinerary and any supporting materials for our security/ops team (brief SOC 2 overview and data handling notes).

We can cover hotel and local travel for your execs. Please also advise if you need a visa support letter for anyone traveling from abroad.

Would you be able to confirm by EOD Friday (Aug 15)?

Thanks,
Anjali Mehta
Head of Data & AI
FinServ Inc
~

Hi Anjali — thanks for the invite and the clear ask. Happy to coordinate. I’m Laura (Executive Assistant to Markus Klein / event lead for onsites) — looping in Marcus and Rachel to align on exec coverage and logistics.

Quick answers and next steps:
- Recommended Redwood attendees for the exec roundtable: Markus Klein (VP Sales), Dev Patel (CTO), and one senior solutions engineer (TBD). Marcus will confirm specific names.
- We can commit to a 3-person workshop team + one exec for the roundtable.
- I’ll prepare a draft agenda and a short SOC 2 one-pager for your security team — will share as attachments once finalized.

A few items I need from you to finalize travel:
1) Preferred arrival/departure windows for Redwood execs (we recommend arriving the evening of Sept 8 and departing late evening Sept 10 or morning Sept 11).
2) Any dietary restrictions for the dinner guests.
3) Point of contact onsite for logistics (AV, room setup, car service).
4) Whether FinServ requires a formal visa support letter.

I’ll send a proposed agenda, travel itinerary, and visa letter by Monday Aug 18 after Marcus confirms attendees.

Warmly,
Laura Bennett

Logistics / recommendations:
- Travel: Markus and Dev will likely fly from SFO (direct to JFK) — ideal flights leave SFO evening Sept 8, arrive early morning Sept 9. Rachel and Aaron can travel morning Sept 9.
- Hotel: we recommend the Grand Harbor Hotel (we have standing corporate rate; close to your HQ).
- Dinner: Markus prefers a private room for the roundtable + dinner; we can route options (Morton's or The Capital Grille).
- Reimbursements / procurement: we’ll book through Concur and invoice FinServ per our standard travel policy. If Finance needs a PO, please share.

Action items I’ll own: confirm final attendee list by Fri Aug 15; finalize preferred dinner venue and send menu/dietary intake; send attendee bios for your pre-read.

- We can confirm a private dining room for Sept 10; Morton's works.
- Dietary restrictions: Rajiv (CEO) is vegetarian; one board member is pescatarian. Please capture numbers when you send final headcount.
- Onsite POC: Sarah Delgado (sarah.delgado@finserv.com) — she’ll coordinate AV and security sign-in.

One more ask: our security team asked for a one-page summary of data handling for dedicated/private deployments (SOC 2 scope, retention defaults, encryption at rest/in transit). If you could attach that to the itinerary, that will speed approvals.

See you soon — Anjali
